description:
## Outcome

A future Scoop manifest installs an accepted signed Windows x86-64 ZIP, exposes `jido`, verifies its checksum, and upgrades without deleting user data.

## Work

1. Add version, architecture, immutable URL, hash, executable mapping, and update fields.
2. Use the accepted signed GitHub release ZIP.
3. Test install, version, help, upgrade, uninstall, and data preservation.
4. Add controlled manifest update automation.
5. Document foreground CLI behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Scoop installs `jido --version` without system OTP.
- [ ] A wrong hash blocks installation.
- [ ] Upgrade replaces program files and preserves user data.
- [ ] The manifest uses immutable release data.

## Tests

Run native Windows Scoop install, upgrade, bad-hash, path, Unicode-profile, and uninstall tests.

## Non-goals

Do not add a daemon, service, Winget, or MSI.
title: Publish a Scoop manifest for a future Windows ZIP
